issues: Fix palette key typo in `tree_3` trunk which uses snow/stone colors (`Z`, `Q`) instead of brown wood tones (`b`, `B`, `t`, `T`), causing bright white/grey vertical stripes on the trunk.
Replace concentric ring ('pillow shading') on trees, rocks, and mountains with unified top-left directional lighting and proper highlight/shadow zones.
Redesign `tile_forest`, `tile_rock`, `tile_mountain`, and `tile_road` to avoid sub-tile 2x2 grid repeating patterns that create ugly checkerboard tiling artifacts when rendered on a map.
Redesign `tile_road` to visually represent a dirt path/trail rather than isolated polka-dot circles.
Fix `deco_1`, `deco_2`, and `deco_3` so flower stems and petals form contiguous plants rooted at the base rather than floating disjointed pixels.
Apply dark 1px outlines (`f` or `g`) around tree canopies and foliage so sprites match the required outline style.
